checkpoints.label: Setup
checkpoints.title: Connected
checkpoints.question: Which ThousandEyes permission must your user carry for the MCP server to work at all?

checkpoints.label: Lab 1
checkpoints.title: Map your digital landscape
checkpoints.question: How many SaaS platforms does the discovery API return a true or false flag for?
checkpoints.hint: Count the keys under saas in the JSON you fetched in Step A.

checkpoints.label: Lab 2
checkpoints.title: Map the estate
checkpoints.question: Which field in a list_tests response tells your agent there is another page to fetch?
checkpoints.hint: It sits beside total and nextCursor. The builder note at the end of Lab 2 names it.

checkpoints.label: Lab 3
checkpoints.title: Triage an alert
checkpoints.question: Which tool returns the hop-by-hop traces, as opposed to the per-agent summary?
checkpoints.hint: Two path tools sit under Tools in play for Lab 3. You want the one the guide says to call only for agents that show loss or latency.

checkpoints.label: Lab 4
checkpoints.title: Us or the internet?
checkpoints.question: Which tool answers "is it us or the internet?" without needing any of your own tests?
checkpoints.hint: Internet Insights. One tool, with a catalogue group of its own.

checkpoints.label: Lab 5
checkpoints.title: Anomalies and an instant test
checkpoints.question: An instant test is billed as how many rounds of a scheduled test?
checkpoints.hint: The warning box at the end of Lab 5 says it in one line.

checkpoints.label: Lab 6
checkpoints.title: Ship the alerting, then clean up
checkpoints.question: In the cleanup prompt, what gets deleted first: the dashboard, the alert rule, or the tests?
checkpoints.hint: Read the delete order in the third prompt of Lab 6.

checkpoints.label: Build 1
checkpoints.title: The te-triage skill
checkpoints.question: How many ThousandEyes tools does te-triage pre-approve on its allowed-tools line?
checkpoints.hint: Count the entries on the allowed-tools line in the skill frontmatter. Every one of them only reads.

checkpoints.label: Build 2
checkpoints.title: Schedule it
checkpoints.question: What must the cloud task's prompt explicitly reference, or the run ignores the alert that fired it?
checkpoints.hint: Option C, step 2. The troubleshooting table at the back of the Field guide has the same answer.

checkpoints.label: Build 3
checkpoints.title: Headless for CI and cron
checkpoints.question: Which flag makes an unattended claude -p run deny anything not allow-listed, instead of asking?
checkpoints.hint: It is the third flag in te-brief.sh under Pattern 1, and the bullet below the script explains what it denies.
